**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation muted: IWM (1W: -4.02% | 1M: -3.70%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; IBIT (1W: +3.79% | 1M: -7.14%) ↑ rising RECOVERY and ARKK (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +3.44%) → flat CORRECTION show selective risk-on in crypto/innovation pockets.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Oil/energy squeeze dominates: USO (1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +26.26% | 1M: +36.03%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; copper weak: CPER (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -1.82%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; gold in CORRECTION: GLD (1W: -2.12% | 1M: +4.30%) ↓ falling CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing breadth: XLE (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND with BNO/USO surging; natural gas rebound: UNG (1W: +10.68% | 1M: -5.27%) ↑ rising RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Energy (XLE, USO, BNO) ABOVE TREND across timeframes; volatility and credit confirmations via VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +23.43% | 1M: +29.01%) ↑ rising and HYG/LQD split. DIVERGENCE: TLT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +2.56%) CORRECTION and GLD (1W: -2.12% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION are minor divergences — watch but not regime changing.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor Energy exposure (XLE 1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08% ABOVE TREND; USO 1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66% ABOVE TREND) and monitor volatility with VXX (1W: +23.43% | 1M: +29.01% ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to small caps and weak EM: IWM (1W: -4.02% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND and EEM (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%) ABOVE TREND, XOP/USO/BNO showing strength. BEARISH: Small caps/EM — IWM (1W: -4.02% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND, EEM (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil — USO (1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +26.26% | 1M: +36.03%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Industrial metals and silver — CPER (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND, SLV (1W: -10.65% | 1M: -4.09%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX ~35 (VXX 1W: +23.43% | 1M: +29.01% ABOVE TREND) as a volatility breakpoint; monitor HYG vs LQD split via HYG (1W: -0.79% | 1M: -0.67% BELOW TREND) and LQD (1W: -1.02% | 1M: +0.52% CORRECTION) for credit stress; SPY support area with SPY (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -2.01%) BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, VXX (1W: +23.43% | 1M: +29.01%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and HYG/LQD divergence confirm elevated risk. Energy ETFs (XLE 1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08% ABOVE TREND; USO 1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66% ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength. Key risk is rising volatility and worsening credit signals — monitor VXX and the HYG/LQD split closely.
